ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a circle, E is on the left side, B is on the right side, and line segment EB passes horizontally through the center of the circle, so EB is a diameter. A is above the circle, D and C are below the circle, and the chords EA, AB, ED, BC, and DC are drawn in the figure; among them, DC appears to be parallel to EB, and AB is parallel to ED. Then reason: Because EB is a diameter, by Thales' theorem, in triangle AEB, ∠EAB = 90°. It is known that ∠AEB : ∠ABE = 4 : 5, and the sum of these two angles is 90°, so let them be 4x and 5x respectively, then 9x = 90°, x = 10°. Therefore ∠AEB = 40°, ∠ABE = 50°. Also because AB ∥ ED, and EB is in the same straight-line direction, ∠BED = ∠ABE = 50°. Points B, C, D, and E are all on the same circle, quadrilateral BCDE is a cyclic quadrilateral, and opposite angles are supplementary, therefore ∠BCD = 180° - ∠BED = 180° - 50° = 130°.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as a circle with E and B opposite ends of a horizontal diameter, A on the upper arc, and D,C on the lower arc; chords EA, AB, ED, BC, and DC are drawn. From the text, EB is a diameter, AB is parallel to ED, and ∠AEB:∠ABE = 4:5. Use Thales' theorem on triangle AEB: since EB is a diameter, ∠EAB = 90°, so the other two angles sum to 90°. The ratio 4:5 gives ∠AEB = 40° and ∠ABE = 50°. Because AB ∥ ED and EB is the same line as BE, the angle ∠BED equals ∠ABE = 50°. Since B,C,D,E lie on the same circle, opposite angles of cyclic quadrilateral BCDE are supplementary, so ∠BCD = 180° − ∠BED = 130°.

method.method_draft: Use an arc-measure approach. From the image, take E and B as endpoints of a diameter, with A on the upper semicircle and D,C on the lower arc; AB and ED are visually corresponding slanted chords, and DC is the lower horizontal chord. From the text, EB is a diameter and ∠AEB:∠ABE = 4:5, so in right triangle AEB the angles are ∠AEB = 40° and ∠ABE = 50°. By the inscribed-angle theorem, ∠ABE = 50° intercepts arc AE of measure 100°. Because AB ∥ ED, the corresponding parallel chords force the intercepted arcs AE and BD to be equal, so the minor arc BD through C has measure 100°. Angle BCD intercepts the other, major arc BD, whose measure is 360° − 100° = 260°. Therefore ∠BCD = 260°/2 = 130°.
method.CoT_raw:

推理：因为 EB 是直径，所以三角形 AEB 中 ∠EAB = 90°。已知 ∠AEB : ∠ABE = 4 : 5，而这两个锐角和为 90°，所以 4x + 5x = 90°，x = 10°。因此 ∠AEB = 40°，∠ABE = 50°。

用圆周角定理，∠ABE = 50° 截对弧 AE，所以弧 AE 的度数为 2 × 50° = 100°。由于 AB ∥ ED，平行弦 AB 和 ED 所夹的对应弧相等，因此弧 AE 与较小弧 BD 相等，所以经过下方 C 的小弧 BD 为 100°。

角 BCD 的顶点 C 在这条小弧 BD 上，因此 ∠BCD 截对的是不含 C 的另一条大弧 BD。该大弧 BD 的度数为 360° − 100° = 260°。再次由圆周角定理，∠BCD = 260° / 2 = 130°。
